title.zh: 嘉信理财全面开放加密交易，CEO称将以加密和预测市场拓展交易收入
title.en: 嘉信理财全面开放加密交易，CEO称将以加密和预测市场拓展交易收入

current_state.zh: Charles Schwab has broadly rolled out spot bitcoin and ether trading to eligible retail clients at a 0.75% fee with Paxos execution and custody, begun phased crypto deposit/withdrawal support, and plans to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink by end-2026 as it targets transaction revenue alongside prediction markets.
